name: travel-insurance-claims-analysis
what_it_holds: Commits travel_insurance.csv, the well-known Kaggle 'Travel Insurance' dataset from a Singapore-based third-party travel insurance servicer: >63,000 records, 11 columns (Claim Status, Agency, Agency Type, Distribution Channel, Product Name, Duration, Destination, Net Sales, Commission, Gender, Age). Cross-sectional (not a time series with dates), and the analysis flags serious data-quality problems (ages 0-118, ~44K missing gender, negative sales/duration, >35K zero-commission rows). Updated 2025-11-07.
why_useful: This is the single, widely-recirculated Kaggle travel-insurance dataset -- at least 6 near-identical repos on GitHub reanalyze it (KushalS25, adibhattar95, mek9wm, Ivan-R-Septian, S-CHAN11 all found via the same gh search). It is cross-sectional with no dates, so it cannot support the RNPL/cancellation-rate time-series work in gap #3; flagging once for completeness, not as a genuine new find.
time_coverage: cross-sectional snapshot, no date field confirmed
geography: Singapore-based agency, destinations global (categorical field, not geocoded)
duplicate_of_holding: one of >=6 near-identical repos reanalyzing the same Kaggle 'Travel Insurance' CSV; do not re-flag the others (KushalS25/CART-RANDOM-FOREST-ANN-CLASSIFIERS, adibhattar95/Fraud-Claim-Detection-in-Travel-Insurance, mek9wm/travel-insurance_decision-tree_random-forest, Ivan-R-Septian/Travel-Insurance-Claim-Prediction-and-Risk-Optimization, S-CHAN11/Insurance-Claim-Prediction)

name: turno-mcp
what_it_holds: Multi-tenant MCP server wrapping the Turno (formerly TurnoverBnB) v2 REST API: 49 tools covering properties, bookings, projects, cleaners, webhooks. No committed data — it is a live client that requires an authenticated Turno account/API key to pull anything (turnaround-time bookings, cleaner assignments, project status per property). AGPL-3.0, updated 10 Sep 2026, 0 stars.
why_useful: Confirms Turno exposes a documented v2 API (properties/bookings/cleaners) that could in principle be queried for turnover cadence / cleaner-marketplace activity as a nights-proxy, but there is no public dataset and no free sample; would need our own paid Turno account to pull anything, which is outside a cataloguing pass.
themes: Vacation rental damage/turnover/cleaning marketplaces (Turno, TurnoverBnB), STR supply services (Airbnb photographer, key exchange) datasets
wildcard: an Airbnb superhost / small property manager who uses open-s
why_all: Confirms Turno exposes a documented v2 API (properties/bookings/cleaners) that could in principle be queried for turnover cadence / cleaner-marketplace activity as a nights-proxy, but there is no public dataset and no free sample; would need our own paid Turno account to pull anything, which is outside a cataloguing pass.

Only a live method for pulling per-property Turno turnover/cleaning-schedule data (a real STR-supply signal), but requires the requester's own paid Turno account credentials — no aggregate/public data accessible. Could theoretically expose booking-adjacent scheduling cadence (a nights/turnover proxy) if the team or a contact already runs Turno for properties, but not a market-wide dataset.

Turno is the dominant STR cleaning-scheduler; its 'bookings'/'blocked dates' objects are effectively a real-time occupancy calendar per managed property. Documents exactly what fields a professional property manager's turnover system tracks (checkout->clean->next-checkin cadence), which is the ground-truth structure any nights/turnover proxy would need to reconstruct if a cooperating host/PM ever shared exports.
